metaShifts.theme: The BKB Dominance & Physical Damage Supremacy
metaShifts.description: The significant buff to Black King Bar's magic resistance (50% to 60%) is the defining change, making magic burst far less effective against activated BKB. This heavily favors physical damage cores who can utilize BKB to freely attack, amplifying the 'Return of the Right-Click Carry & Physical Burst' theme. Concurrently, nerfs to key magic items like Parasma, Shiva's Guard, and Veil of Discord further diminish the viability of sustained magic damage cores, pushing the meta towards physical damage or burst magic that can bypass BKB windows.

metaShifts.theme: Accelerated Mid-Game Power Spikes & Objective Control
metaShifts.description: Numerous item cost reductions across the board (Orchid, MKB, Meteor Hammer, Helm of the Overlord, Gleipnir, Yasha/Sange/Kaya components) mean heroes hit their critical item timings much faster. This accelerates the game tempo, reinforcing the 'Early Game Pressure & Objective Taking' theme. Teams that can leverage these quicker power spikes to secure objectives and force mid-game teamfights will gain a significant advantage.

metaShifts.theme: Support Itemization Shift & Early Game Utility
metaShifts.description: While many popular supports received direct nerfs, the buffs to Vladmir's Offering (cheaper, armor, mana regen) and Helm of the Overlord (significantly cheaper) provide strong early game utility and pushing power. This encourages supports to invest in these items to enable faster objective taking and sustain for their cores, shifting focus towards early teamfight and aura presence rather than pure disable or burst.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: The increase in Avatar Magic Resistance from 50% to 60% is a monumental buff, making BKB an even more indispensable item for cores to survive and deal damage in teamfights, especially against magic-heavy lineups.

The Empower Spell base damage increase from 100 to 150 makes Khanda a much more potent burst damage item, synergizing with heroes who can frequently apply attacks with their abilities or right-clicks.

A significant recipe cost decrease makes Orchid Malevolence much cheaper and faster to acquire, enabling earlier silence and damage amplification for heroes who rely on picking off targets or shutting down key spellcasters.
The substantial recipe cost decrease makes Helm of the Overlord significantly cheaper, allowing heroes to acquire its powerful aura and controlled creep much earlier for pushing and map control.
Now providing +2 Armor and +0.75 Mana Regen, alongside its existing benefits, makes Vladmir's Offering a stronger early game aura item for teamfights and sustained pushes, despite minor aura nerfs.
A recipe cost decrease makes MKB cheaper and more accessible, providing a faster counter to evasion and a reliable damage boost for right-click carries.
Increased spell lifesteal and decreased cooldown across all levels make Dagon a more efficient and impactful burst magic damage item, especially for heroes who can leverage its instant damage.

Cheaper total cost, increased evasion, and improved health regen/lifesteal amp make Halberd a more attractive defensive and offensive item for strength and agility cores, providing both survivability and a powerful disarm.
The increase in Strength bonus from +35 to +40 makes Heart an even more potent item for tankiness and damage for Strength heroes, solidifying its role as a late-game anchor.
The Nullify projectile speed increase from 1100 to 1800 makes the item significantly more reliable for catching elusive targets and dispelling buffs, enhancing its utility in the mid to late game.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Increased recipe cost and total cost, combined with the removal of AoE on Suppress, significantly nerfs Disperser's utility and accessibility, making it a less appealing choice for mana burn and slow application. It also no longer affects the target and user, only the target and user if they are the same entity, which is a nerf to its previous flexibility.

Increased recipe cost and total cost, along with decreased armor, all attributes, and health regen, make Shiva's Guard a much weaker and more expensive defensive item, reducing its value for tanky intelligence cores and offlaners.

Now requiring an additional recipe and having its Intelligence bonus decreased, Parasma becomes more expensive and provides less raw stats, reducing its efficiency as a spell amplification item for intelligence cores.

Increased recipe cost and total cost, decreased magic resistance, and a significantly shorter debuff duration make Mage Slayer less effective as an anti-magic item, reducing its overall value for cores looking to counter spellcasters.
A decrease in Health bonus from +300 to +250 makes Eternal Shroud a less efficient source of raw tankiness, slightly reducing its appeal for heroes seeking magic resistance and health sustain.

Decreased All Attributes, Armor, and Health Regen make Veil of Discord a weaker early game item, reducing its overall value as a stat-efficient spell amplification tool for supports and magic-damage offlaners.
A decrease in Armor bonus makes Wraith Band a less effective early game item for agility carries, slightly impacting their laning survivability and last-hitting potential.
A decrease in Armor bonus from +5 to +4 makes Helm of Iron Will a less efficient component for early game tankiness, slightly impacting its value in various item builds.

Carry.explanation: Agility gain and Stifling Dagger cast range buffs, combined with cheaper MKB, Halberd, and strong Yasha-line items, position PA as a premier physical damage carry in the BKB-dominant meta.

Base Strength and Reflection cooldown buffs improve his early game and teamfight presence. He benefits immensely from the BKB meta and the continued strength of Yasha-line items for pushing and right-click damage.

Reality Rift pull distance buff, coupled with the Heart of Tarrasque strength buff and the general physical damage meta, makes CK a formidable tanky illusion carry who thrives on sustained right-click.

While he received base armor and talent nerfs, the Time Dilation cooldown progression buff is significant. More importantly, the BKB buff allows him to survive magic burst and freely Chronosphere, making him a strong physical damage threat.

Mid.explanation: Diabolic Edict damage and Pulse Nova mana cost buffs significantly increase his burst and sustained magic damage output. He can leverage cheaper Kaya and Dagon for faster power spikes, making him a strong mid-game threat despite the BKB meta.

No direct hero nerfs, but benefits from cheaper MKB, Heaven's Halberd, and the Sange/Kaya/Yasha line items. His physical damage and BKB-piercing control (Shield Crash, Rolling Thunder) are highly valued in this meta.

No direct hero nerfs, but benefits from cheaper Orchid Malevolence for early pick-offs and the Dagon buff for burst. His versatility allows him to adapt to the BKB meta with physical builds or BKB-piercing control.

No direct hero nerfs, but benefits from the Heart of Tarrasque strength buff and is naturally tanky. His BKB-piercing disable (Dismember) is highly valuable in a meta where magic damage is less effective.

Offlane.explanation: Repel now correctly nullifies Pure damage, a massive defensive buff that makes him an unparalleled protector. He benefits from the Sange line and Heart of Tarrasque buffs, making him a tanky and impactful offlaner.

Skewer talent changes are mixed, but the fixed interaction is a quality-of-life improvement. His Empower remains incredibly strong for physical carries, and his BKB-piercing Reverse Polarity is invaluable in the current meta.
No direct hero nerfs, but benefits from the Heart of Tarrasque strength buff and the general tankiness meta. His initiation and BKB-piercing stun are highly effective.

No direct hero nerfs, but benefits from the Vladmir's Offering buff for early teamfight and push. His Pit of Malice provides BKB-piercing control, and his aura reduces enemy damage, making him a strong frontliner.

SoftSupport.explanation: While Divine Favor gained a mana cost, the Helm of the Overlord is significantly cheaper, allowing Chen to accelerate his early push and aura game, impacting the map much earlier with powerful creeps.

Death Ward Scepter no longer grants True Strike (a nerf), but the Dagon buff makes a burst magic damage build more viable. He can contribute significant damage in a BKB meta by focusing on burst rather than sustained magic.

No direct hero nerfs, but benefits from cheaper Orb of Corrosion for laning and the general faster tempo. Her long-range stun and global mobility are always valuable, especially for setting up early kills.
No direct hero nerfs, but benefits from cheaper Orchid Malevolence for early pick-offs. Her BKB-piercing disables (Bramble Maze, Terrorize) are highly effective in the current meta.

HardSupport.explanation: Repel's fix to nullify Pure damage is a game-changer for a hard support, offering unparalleled protection to cores. He can leverage cheaper Vladmir's Offering for early teamfight sustain.

No direct hero nerfs, and benefits from the Vladmir's Offering buff for early teamfights and sustain. His Tombstone remains a powerful objective-taking and teamfight tool, especially in a faster-paced meta.

No direct hero nerfs, and benefits from the cheaper Orb of Venom for aggressive laning. His natural tankiness and strong early game harass make him a reliable hard support in a meta that values early impact.

Despite the Scepter nerf, the Dagon buff allows for a burst-oriented hard support build. His Paralyzing Cask and Maledict still provide strong early game control and damage, especially when paired with Dagon.
The significantly cheaper Helm of the Overlord allows Chen to accelerate his early push and aura game as a hard support, providing strong map control and objective pressure from minute one.

Carry.explanation: Spirit Bear movement speed and cooldown nerfs significantly reduce his early game pressure, farming efficiency, and overall scaling, making him less impactful in a faster-paced meta where early aggression is key.

Pounce cooldown increased, making his initiation, escape, and overall mobility less frequent. This reduces his ability to snowball and pick off targets, especially against teams with faster item timings.

Base Strength and Strength gain decreased, along with a massive Spark Wraith duration nerf, severely impacts his survivability, scaling, and map control, making him a much weaker carry in all stages of the game.

Nethertoxin max DPS and Corrosive Skin radius decreased, reducing his overall damage output and area control. These nerfs make him less effective at dominating lanes and contributing to mid-game teamfights.

Dig health restore and MegaMeepo stats decreased, significantly reducing his survivability and scaling potential. These nerfs make him much more vulnerable to burst and less effective at sustaining in fights.

Mid.explanation: Aghanim's Scepter damage barrier decreased, making him less tanky against burst. More critically, the BKB buff significantly reduces the impact of his magic damage, making him less effective against activated BKBs.

Exorcism active movement bonus decreased, reducing her ability to chase, escape, and position effectively during her ultimate. This makes her less potent in objective pushes and teamfights, especially in a BKB meta.
Sleight of Fist mana cost increased, making him more mana-hungry in the early to mid-game. This impacts his ability to farm, harass, and participate in skirmishes without constant mana replenishment.

Nethertoxin max DPS and Corrosive Skin radius decreased, reducing his overall damage output and area control. These nerfs make him less effective at dominating lanes and contributing to mid-game teamfights.

While not directly nerfed, the BKB buff makes his magic-heavy builds less effective against activated BKBs. He needs to adapt to more physical or BKB-piercing control builds, which might not be optimal for all players.

Offlane.explanation: Scorched Earth movement speed and Doom duration decreased, reducing his mobility, farming speed, and the impact of his ultimate. These nerfs make him less effective at controlling fights and picking off key targets.

Flamethrower damage per second decreased, reducing his sustained damage output and farming speed. This makes him less effective at clearing waves and contributing to teamfights, especially against tanky cores.
Borrowed Time cooldown increased, making his ultimate less frequently available for teamfights and critical saves. This reduces his overall survivability and impact as a frontliner.
Flamebreak radius decreased, making it harder to land multi-hero Flamebreaks and control teamfights. This reduces his overall area denial and damage output, especially in crowded engagements.
Malefice cast range decreased, making it harder to initiate with his primary stun and secure early kills. This impacts his ability to roam and set up Black Holes effectively.

SoftSupport.explanation: Magic Missile cooldown increased and Wave of Terror damage decreased, significantly reducing her early game impact, harass, and ability to secure kills in lane. These nerfs make her a weaker soft support option.

Earth Spike cooldown increased and Mana Drain slow/bonus decreased, reducing his control, utility, and ability to gank effectively. These nerfs make him less impactful in the early and mid-game skirmishes.

Base damage decreased, Sprout damage aura nerfed, and Teleportation cooldown increased. These nerfs hit his early game harass, farming, and global presence, making him a less effective roaming or greedy soft support.
Acorn Shot slow duration decreased, reducing her ability to kite, set up kills, and control targets. This impacts her overall utility and damage output as a soft support.

While not directly nerfed, the BKB buff makes his magic damage less effective against activated BKBs. Additionally, nerfs to items like Parasma and Shiva's Guard, which he often builds, indirectly weaken him.

HardSupport.explanation: Magic Missile cooldown increased and Wave of Terror damage decreased, significantly reducing her early game impact, harass, and ability to secure kills in lane. These nerfs make her a weaker hard support option.

Earth Spike cooldown increased and Mana Drain slow/bonus decreased, reducing his control, utility, and ability to gank effectively. These nerfs make him less impactful in the early and mid-game skirmishes.
Base damage decreased, Sprout damage aura nerfed, and Teleportation cooldown increased. These nerfs hit his early game harass, farming, and global presence, making him a less effective hard support.
Malefice cast range decreased, making it harder to initiate with his primary stun and secure early kills. This impacts his ability to roam and set up Black Holes effectively as a hard support.

No direct hero nerfs, but the BKB buff makes his magic damage less impactful against activated BKBs. He doesn't directly benefit from the cheaper physical/aura items, making him less impactful compared to other supports.
